Coffee Stock Entries
fields.description: Kaitet Ltd. has no company default cost centre or stock adjustment account, so every coffee stock entry (cherry received, drying to bins, milling, transfers) takes them from here.

fields.label: Cost Centre
fields.description: Cost centre on every row of coffee stock entries.

fields.label: Stock Adjustment Account
fields.description: Difference account on every row of coffee stock entries.

fields.label: Endebess (Outgrower)
fields.description: Point these at whatever names you used when creating the service Items, Price List, and Grower Type attribute in the UI. Leave blank to disable auto-populate — the SO items table then stays fully manual.
Price List rates are pulled from when auto-populating the SO items table. Falls back to the SO's own selling_price_list.
fields.label: Endebess Price List

fields.description: Service item billed per tonne of parchment received.

fields.description: Suffix appended to a grade item_code to resolve its Outgrower variant (e.g. 'AA' + '-OG' = 'AA-OG').
fields.label: Outgrower Variant Suffix
Daily Report Recipients
fields.description: Email addresses, one per line or comma-separated. Each evening they get the day's cherry harvested (buckets and kg), expected clean coffee and the pickers paid.
